Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has lost $7.4 billion in estimated wealth in just 30 minutes of trading after admitting to an affair, triggering a storm of controversy around the world's leading AI chipmaker.
Huang's net worth fell from $162.2 billion to $154.7 billion as Nvidia shares plunged amid reports of a possible Chinese intelligence connection involving a woman he was reportedly associated with. The fall pushed him below Warren Buffett and Larry Ellison in Forbes' billionaire rankings.
